title: Audit and remediate accessibility for annotation overlays, token contrast, and keyboard flows
creator: Maya Thompson
description:
Summary: Perform a focused accessibility audit and remediation for the annotation-related surface across the design system: floating annotation overlays (comment bubbles, inline note popovers), annotation controls (reply, resolve, delete), and chart-bound annotation marks. Deliverables: 1) set of updated contrast token recommendations for annotation UI (background, border, focus outline, action buttons), 2) updated keyboard interaction spec for annotation lifecycle (open, traverse, reply, confirm resolve, cancel), 3) VPAT evidence package with test scripts and screenreader recordings, 4) annotated Figma components and a dev handoff PR spec.

Scope / Why: Annotation UI is used across editor embeds, dashboards, and charts. Initial heuristic and automated scans surfaced multiple failures: insufficient contrast for badge focus outline at small sizes, missing aria-expanded on popovers, and inconsistent tab order when opening overlay from chart mark. These gaps affect keyboard-only and screen reader users and need prioritized remediation before the 2026.03 release.

Approach: 1) Audit: manual keyboard + NVDA/VoiceOver pass on core annotation patterns + automation (aXe) run across sample pages. 2) Tokens: propose contrast delta adjustments and a pair of semantic tokens (annotation-bg / annotation-border) with accessible fallbacks for high-density themes. 3) Interaction spec: define roving tabindex behavior, focus trapping rules for popovers, and explicit aria-labels/roles for reply/resolution actions. 4) VPAT: compile evidence matrix mapping WCAG success criteria -> test artifacts -> remediation status. 5) Handoff: Figma updates, token migration guide, signed-off acceptance tests for QA and Eng.

Trade-offs: Stronger contrast on annotation badges increases visual weight in dense UIs; proposing a density-aware token that scales the outline thickness instead of color shift to preserve brand palette in enterprise themes. Weights of keyboard trapping: choose focus trap with escape to close + explicit return focus to originating chart mark to support discoverability for screen reader users.

Links & artifacts: Confluence audit doc: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/DS/Annotation+Overlay+Accessibility+Audit
Figma file (components & flows): https://www.figma.com/file/Example/annotation-components
Token spreadsheet: https://docs.google.com/spreadsheets/d/annotations-token-matrix

comments: 2026-02-26 — Maya T.: Initial audit complete for annotation overlay: recorded NVDA and VoiceOver passes for web and macOS. Found three high-priority failures: (1) popover lacks aria-expanded on trigger, (2) focusable order inside popover is inconsistent across browsers, (3) contrast ratio for small icon-only action buttons dips below 3:1 in compact density. Captured screenshots and screen recordings in Confluence.

2026-03-01 — Ethan R.: Proposed token changes uploaded to token sheet. Suggest annotation-border -> token 'b-annotation-1' at #1A2B3C with 3px outline on compact, 2px on normal density. Calling out potential visual regression with charts—will create A/B screenshots for PM signoff.

2026-03-03 — Priya K. (PM): We need a short list of customer use-cases impacted (annotations on charts, in doc editor, comment threads). Prioritize charts and editor embed first. Add to acceptance criteria: 'restore explicit keyboard return focus to originating element after overlay close'.

2026-03-05 — Design review (Alex L.): Reviewed keyboard flow; suggested roving tabindex for action buttons and explicit aria-describedby linking the popover to the originating annotation for context. Also recommended adding 'aria-live' updates when an annotation is resolved. Added specifics to spec.

2026-03-08 — Eng sync (Sara M.): ENG asked for small API change: annotation triggers must include 'data-annotation-id' for deterministic focus return. Eng estimates 2 dev days for chart-binding fix and 3 days for overlay a11y behavior across embed surfaces. Added ENG-2234 as dependency.

2026-03-10 — Maya T.: VPAT evidence matrix skeleton created; started screenreader audio exports (macOS VoiceOver) and step-by-step keyboard test scripts. Need one more reviewer to sign off before marking criteria as 'fixed' in VPAT.

2026-03-12 — Ethan R.: Implemented Figma updates and token variants. Uploaded annotated component examples and included 'compact' vs 'standard' density screenshots. Created design PR: https://github.com/redwood/infra-ux/pull/4621 — awaiting Eng review (ENG-2234).
